summary: Say the counting numbers from 1 to 20 in order, with none skipped or mixed up.
Count up to 10 things, one number for each, and know the last number said tells how many.
Tell how many are in a small group, up to 5, at a glance without counting.
Name written numbers from 1 to 10 and match a number up to 5 to a group that size.
Compare two small groups as more, fewer or the same, and add or take away with up to 6 objects.
Compare things as bigger, longer or heavier, and line a few up from smallest to biggest.
Sort things into groups by one or more features, like color, size or shape.
Spot, copy and continue simple AB patterns of colors, shapes or sizes.
Name circles, squares, triangles and rectangles of any size or turn, and use shapes to make pictures.
Use and follow position words like under, next to, inside and around.
